not_checked.why: Flattened PNG supplied; no source file or text layers.

findings.observed: Wordmark sits 18px from the right edge. Clear space requires 34px (1x cap-height of 34px wordmark).
findings.fix: Increase right margin to 34px minimum, or switch to the mark-only lockup at this width.

findings.observed: Headline claims 'the longest-lasting finish' with no asterisk and no substantiation line.
findings.fix: Add the approved substantiation footnote, or drop to the non-comparative 'a long-lasting finish'.

findings.observed: Accent Amber #E8A33D covers ~31% of the canvas. Rule caps accent share at 10%.
findings.fix: Reduce the amber field to a supporting element; take the background to Bone #F4F1EC.

findings.observed: Subhead renders at 27px; the type scale has no 27px step (24 / 32 are adjacent).
findings.fix: Set to 24px, or 32px if the hierarchy needs the weight.

findings.observed: Product is centred. Corpus convention is off-centre with copy in the negative space (ex-p-04).
findings.fix: Shift product to the right third; move copy into the left negative space.

findings.observed: Delivered at 1080x1080 (1:1). Brief specified Meta feed, where 4:5 is the brand's default.

observations.note: The shadow under the product reads slightly heavier than the rest of the AW26 set. No rule covers shadow weight — worth a rule if the art director agrees it is a convention.
